component.name: Checkbox
component.description: A single on/off choice with a visible text label. Wraps a native <input type="checkbox"> inside its <label>, so clicking the label toggles the box, the value submits with an ordinary HTML form, and controlled/uncontrolled use follows the native checked/defaultChecked/onChange contract. Unchecked: input background with a strong input border. Checked: brand-filled box with an inverted check glyph. Disabled works in both states.

when: A single independent on/off setting in a form (e.g. notification preferences)
A list of independent options where any number may be selected
Consent or opt-in that submits with a form

patterns.name: preference-group
patterns.description: A labelled vertical group of independent Checkboxes inside a settings Card. The group is a role=group named by the section heading.
patterns.tree: Card > Stack(gap=lg) > [Heading, Stack(gap=sm, role=group, aria-labelledby=<heading id>) > [Checkbox, Checkbox, Checkbox]]

antiPatterns.scenario: Using Checkbox to filter content or trigger an immediate page action
antiPatterns.reason: Checkbox is a form input whose value is read on submit or by app state; filter toggles are buttons with aria-pressed.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use Chip for filter toggles and Button for actions.

antiPatterns.scenario: Using several Checkboxes for mutually exclusive choices
antiPatterns.reason: Checkboxes are independent; screen readers announce each as its own on/off control.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use Select (or native radio inputs) for one-of-many choices.

antiPatterns.scenario: Rendering the label as a separate Text next to the Checkbox
antiPatterns.reason: The label must live inside the component's <label> so it names the input and toggles it on click.
antiPatterns.alternative: Pass the text through the label prop.

antiPatterns.scenario: Passing type, children or a custom check glyph
antiPatterns.reason: Checkbox owns its native type and glyph; the prop type excludes type and children.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use the label prop for text; the check glyph is fixed.

purpose.false: Unchecked: input background with input-default border.
purpose.true: Checked: brand-filled box (button.accent.default) with an inverted check glyph.

states.description: Unchecked. Input background, input-default border, default label text.
Unchecked: input-hover border. Checked: button.accent.hover fill.
Brand fill with inverted check; set via checked or defaultChecked.
Disabled border (unchecked) or disabled fill (checked); label in disabled text; interaction blocked natively.

ariaAttributes: Native checked state (announced as checked/not checked) — no aria-checked needed
Accessible name from the wrapping <label> (the label prop)

keyboardInteractions.action: Toggles the checkbox and fires onChange
Moves focus to the next focusable element; disabled checkboxes are skipped

accessibility.notes: Native <input type="checkbox"> with appearance: none, so focus ring, form submission (name/value), required and disabled are all native. The check glyph is aria-hidden. Group related checkboxes in a role=group container with an accessible name.
